Real-world scale, 6 metres long, 3 metres deep, 6 metres tall, mast to 10 metres. Grey concrete, gunmetal steel, dust. Plain even lighting, no baked shadows, no ground, no base, no plinth, centred, one object, facing forward. No insignia, flags, patches, text or markings of any kind.
